when_used: One of several registered proprietors transfers an undivided share in the title, leaving the continuing proprietors on the register.

body_text.text: This TRANSFER OF UNDIVIDED SHARE witnesses as follows:
The Transferor(s) HEREBY TRANSFERS the above ({{undivided_share_transferred}}) undivided share(s) in the above property
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act(No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, if any:
The Transferee(s) and the Continuing Proprietor(s) declare that they shall hold the property comprised in the above Title in trust for each other as:-
Tenants in common in the following shares:-
IN WITNESS the Transferor and the Transferee (and the Continuing Proprietor) have signed this Transfer as a deed.

extra_blocks.signed_label: SIGNED as a deed by the

foot_notes: **The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
